```python
import json

# An atom is (relation, subject, object); "not:" denotes explicit negation.
def A(relation, subject, obj=""):
    return (relation, subject, obj)

def opposite(atom):
    p, s, o = atom
    return A(p[4:] if p.startswith("not:") else "not:" + p, s, o)

facts = {
    A("name", "ant", "Tessa"),
    A("money", "coyote", "86"),
    A("unites", "dugong", "flamingo"),
    A("suspects", "elk", "woodpecker"),
    A("dreamed_of", "flamingo", "luxury_aircraft"),
    A("occupation", "flamingo", "teacher_assistant"),
    A("friends", "gadwall", "3"),
    A("instrument", "gadwall", "saxophone"),
    A("notebook", "goat", "18x14"),
    A("lazy_friends", "otter", "2"),
    A("nonlazy_friends", "otter", "7"),
    A("wants_to_see", "reindeer", "flamingo"),
    A("instrument", "songbird", "cello"),
    A("name", "songbird", "Teddy"),
    A("money", "walrus", "57"),
    A("not:creates_castle", "duck", "starling"),
}
semantic_evidence = {}

def semantic(atom, calculation):
    facts.add(atom)
    semantic_evidence[atom] = calculation

if 86 > 57:
    semantic(A("richer", "coyote", "walrus"), "86 > 57")
if 2 + 7 < 13:
    semantic(A("friends_under_13", "otter"), "2 + 7 = 9 < 13")
# Exact tenths of an inch; allow rotation in the plane.
if any(w <= 178 and h <= 238 for w, h in ((180, 140), (140, 180))):
    semantic(A("notebook_fits", "goat"), "140 <= 178 and 180 <= 238 (rotated)")
if "Teddy"[0] == "Tessa"[0]:
    semantic(A("same_name_initial", "songbird", "ant"), "Teddy[0] = Tessa[0] = T")
semantic(A("works_in_education", "flamingo"), "teacher assistant works in education")
for animal, instrument in (("gadwall", "saxophone"), ("songbird", "cello")):
    semantic(A("has_instrument", animal), instrument + " is a musical instrument")

rules = []
def R(number, head, *body):
    rules.append((number, head, body))

x = "$x"
R(1, A("not:borrows_weapon", "coyote", "dinosaur"), A("suspects", x, "dachshund"))
R(2, A("pays", "dinosaur", "pelikan"), A("borrows_weapon", "coyote", "dinosaur"))
R(3, A("enjoys", x, "fish"), A("not:swims_by", x, "owl"))
R(4, A("unites", "flamingo", "vampire"), A("brings_oil_tank", "goat", "flamingo"))
R(5, A("captures_king", "badger", "cougar"), A("swears", x, "otter"))
R(6, A("not:hides_cards", "flamingo", "chihuahua"), A("works_in_education", "flamingo"))
R(7, A("not:shouts", "songbird", "dove"), A("has_instrument", "songbird"))
R(8, A("creates_castle", "songbird", "owl"), A("same_name_initial", "songbird", "ant"))
R(9, A("not:swims_by", "otter", "seahorse"), A("located_in", "otter", "South_America"))
R(10, A("not:dances", "beetle", "pelikan"), A("surrenders", "dalmatian", "beetle"))
R(11, A("negotiates", "goat", "bear"), A("notebook_fits", "goat"))
R(12, A("persuades", x, "mannikin"), A("not:creates_castle", x, "starling"))
R(13, A("not:disarms", x, "peafowl"), A("captures_king", x, "bulldog"))
R(14, A("calls", "bear", "flamingo"), A("negotiates", "goat", "bear"))
R(15, A("photograph", "mermaid", "vampire"), A("captures_king", x, "cougar"))
R(16, A("stops_victory", x, "mannikin"), A("creates_castle", x, "owl"))
R(17, A("suspects", x, "pigeon"), A("not:unites", x, "vampire"), A("swears", x, "leopard"))
R(18, A("stops_victory", "peafowl", "mannikin"), A("reveals_secret", x, "worm"))
R(19, A("shouts", "mannikin", "lizard"), A("destroys_wall", x, "liger"))
R(20, A("wants_to_see", "otter", "dolphin"), A("destroys_wall", x, "poodle"))
R(21, A("reveals_secret", x, "worm"), A("suspects", x, "woodpecker"))
R(22, A("not:shouts", x, "lizard"), A("enjoys", x, "fish"))
R(23, A("neglects", "swallow", "stork"), A("suspects", x, "pigeon"))
R(24, A("not:hides_cards", "flamingo", "chihuahua"), A("owns", "flamingo", "luxury_aircraft"))
R(25, A("destroys_wall", "gadwall", "poodle"), A("has_instrument", "gadwall"))
R(26, A("swears", x, "leopard"), A("photograph", x, "snake"))
R(27, A("shouts", x, "dove"), A("builds_power_plant", x, "german_shepherd"))
R(28, A("borrows_weapon", "coyote", "dinosaur"), A("richer", "coyote", "walrus"))
R(29, A("not:enjoys", x, "beaver"), A("smiles", x, "dinosaur"))
R(30, A("smiles", x, "dinosaur"), A("neglects", x, "stork"))
R(31, A("captures_king", "mannikin", "bulldog"), A("persuades", "duck", "mannikin"))
R(32, A("not:captures_king", x, "bulldog"), A("hugs", x, "dragonfly"))
R(33, A("captures_king", "dolphin", "poodle"), A("wants_to_see", "otter", "dolphin"))
R(34, A("dances", "beetle", "pelikan"), A("pays", x, "pelikan"))
R(35, A("swears", x, "dove"), A("not:shouts", x, "lizard"))
R(36, A("dances", "flamingo", "crab"), A("calls", "bear", "flamingo"))
R(37, A("swims_by", "otter", "seahorse"), A("friends_under_13", "otter"))
R(38, A("not:photograph", "flamingo", "seal"),
  A("wants_to_see", "reindeer", "flamingo"), A("unites", "dugong", "flamingo"))
R(39, A("not:swims_by", "mannikin", "owl"), A("stops_victory", "peafowl", "mannikin"))
R(40, A("photograph", x, "snake"), A("not:surrenders", x, "butterfly"))
R(41, A("not:unites", x, "vampire"), A("dances", x, "crab"))
R(42, A("not:negotiates", "goat", "bear"), A("unites", x, "fangtooth"))
R(43, A("swears", x, "otter"), A("dances", x, "pelikan"))
R(44, A("not:surrenders", x, "butterfly"), A("not:hides_cards", x, "chihuahua"))
R(45, A("not:dances", x, "crab"), A("takes_emperor", x, "bee"))
R(46, A("not:hides_cards", "dove", "swallow"), A("swears", "mannikin", "dove"))

preferred = {(1, 28), (10, 34), (19, 22), (27, 7), (32, 31),
             (4, 41), (42, 11), (45, 36), (9, 37)}

constants = {v for atom in facts for v in atom[1:] if v}
for _, head, body in rules:
    for atom in (head,) + body:
        constants.update(v for v in atom[1:] if v and v != x)

grounded = []
for number, head, body in rules:
    variable = any(x in atom for atom in (head,) + body)
    for value in sorted(constants) if variable else ("",):
        def substitute(atom):
            return tuple(value if term == x else term for term in atom)
        grounded.append((number, substitute(head), tuple(map(substitute, body))))

known = set(facts)
proof = {atom: None for atom in facts}
seen = set()
settled = False

for _ in range(500):
    state = frozenset(known)
    if state in seen:
        break
    seen.add(state)
    applicable = [(n, h, b) for n, h, b in grounded if all(a in known for a in b)]
    by_head = {}
    for n, h, b in applicable:
        by_head.setdefault(h, []).append(n)
    new_known = set(facts)
    new_proof = {atom: None for atom in facts}
    for n, h, b in applicable:
        if any((higher, n) in preferred for higher in by_head.get(opposite(h), ())):
            continue
        new_known.add(h)
        new_proof.setdefault(h, (n, b))
    if new_known == known:
        proof = new_proof
        settled = True
        break
    known, proof = new_known, new_proof

positive = A("enjoys", "swallow", "beaver")
negative = opposite(positive)

if not settled or (positive in known and negative in known):
    print(json.dumps({"final_answer": "UNSUPPORTED", "evidence": "No settled unambiguous result."}))
else:
    answer = ("proved" if positive in known else
              "disproved" if negative in known else "unknown")
    evidence = []
    visited = set()

    def explain(atom):
        if atom in visited:
            return
        visited.add(atom)
        support = proof[atom]
        if support is None:
            evidence.append({"fact": list(atom),
                             "basis": semantic_evidence.get(atom, "given")})
        else:
            number, premises = support
            for premise in premises:
                explain(premise)
            evidence.append({"rule": number, "conclusion": list(atom)})

    if answer != "unknown":
        explain(positive if answer == "proved" else negative)
    else:
        evidence.append({"closure_size": len(known), "neither_polarity_derived": True})
    print(json.dumps({"final_answer": answer, "evidence": evidence}, separators=(",", ":")))
```
